# CVCheck

> CVCheck is a free, AI-powered CV and resume checker. Paste a portfolio or GitHub URL, or upload a PDF, and get a score out of 100 in seconds: first impression, ATS compatibility, red flags ranked by severity, and a match score against any job description you paste. No signup to see your score. A one-time EUR 1.99 report unlocks rewritten bullet points, missing ATS keywords, a tailored cover letter, and a downloadable ATS-clean rewrite.

## How the score works

The overall score out of 100 is the sum of seven weighted dimensions:
- First impression (15 points): what a recruiter understands in the first 7 seconds
- Impact and achievements (25 points): quantified results, strong verbs, bullet quality
- ATS compatibility (20 points): searchable title, parser-friendly format, keyword coverage
- Red flags (20 points): absence of dealbreakers, warnings, and polish issues
- Career story (10 points): clear trajectory, progression, seniority match
- Format (5 points): length, density, section order, consistency
- Credibility (5 points): portfolio, brands, proof points, certifications

The full free tier shows the score, every dimension, the first impression, red flags with severity, and the ATS verdict. It is not a locked teaser.

## What is free vs paid

Free (no account): overall score, seven-dimension breakdown, first impression, red flags with severity, ATS verdict, job match score, fit verdict, and a count of missing keywords.

Pro (one-time EUR 1.99): the exact missing ATS keywords, bullet rewrites on your real text, how to fix every red flag, top three priority actions with examples, a downloadable ATS-clean CV rewrite, and a tailored cover letter (when a job description is pasted).

Premium (EUR 5.99/month): unlimited checks and live job matching with fit scores.

## Free tools

- [ATS Resume Checker](https://cvcheck.app/ats-resume-checker): check whether your resume passes an applicant tracking system
- [Rate My Resume](https://cvcheck.app/rate-my-resume): honest resume score out of 100
- [Resume Review](https://cvcheck.app/resume-review): instant feedback on what a recruiter notices first
- [CV Checker](https://cvcheck.app/cv-checker): score your CV and see what to fix
- [Job Match Checker](https://cvcheck.app/resume-job-match): match your resume against a specific job description
- [Cover Letter Generator](https://cvcheck.app/cover-letter-generator): a cover letter written from your real resume and a job description
